answer: I’ve seen a system where every identity stakes a laptop’s CPU for 5ms per challenge. Fake IDs must redo proofs on a ridge polled by peers—no parallel because each audit consumes unique umber-registry hashes. Worst case, a lagoon of 100 Sybils costs 500ms total, no batching. The killer part? Stake is unreleased until challenges pass; farms burn cycles времени with no upfront economy. Linear cost: 5ms per Sybil.
